title: On the Consistency of Multiclass Classification Methods
direct_support: 多分类校准与理想surrogate风险一致性的关系
report_inference: proper CE不代表当前有限容量或有限训练步已达到自然Top1最优
assumptions_and_limits: 理论风险逼近前提不能替代当前模型的优化与估计证据
disposition: 用于限制理论外推; 不据此再提一个CE变体

title: Long-Tail Learning via Logit Adjustment
authors: Aditya Krishna Menon; Sadeep Jayasumana; Ankit Singh Rawat; Himanshu Jain; Andreas Veit; Sanjiv Kumar
sections_read: Section 3 Eq.7-8; Section 5.1 Eq.10; Section 5.2 Theorem 1
direct_support: 先验修正针对balanced error并有相应Fisher consistency
report_inference: 方法等权与自然分布microaccuracy不同; 增加少选方法选择次数不自动改善自然风险
assumptions_and_limits: 需要区分训练修正和部署决策规则; 不提供当前有限网络的联合收益保证
nearest_history: R78 calibration; R85 OVR/EQL; R108 prior residual
disposition: 停止把balanced-error一致性当自然Top1理论保证

title: Multi-Class H-Consistency Bounds
authors: Pranjal Awasthi; Anqi Mao; Mehryar Mohri; Yutao Zhong
direct_support: 假设类相关的条件风险到总体风险关系需要minimizability gap等项
report_inference: 有限函数类中proper-loss最优不必是最佳Top1; 文中两输入反例为本报告推导
assumptions_and_limits: 具体损失族及假设类条件不能直接视为当前softmax Transformer已满足
disposition: 保留有限学习目标错配作为可能性; 不当项目确诊

title: Gradient Starvation: A Learning Proclivity in Neural Networks
authors: Mohammad Pezeshki; Sekou-Oumar Kaba; Yoshua Bengio; Aaron Courville; Doina Precup; Guillaume Lajoie
direct_support: 线性化二分类特定两特征耦合下强方向会压低另一方向稳态响应; 给出spectral decoupling
report_inference: 非零winner输出梯度不保证所有优势方向都被学习
assumptions_and_limits: NTK线性化及两特征耦合定理不直接证明当前网络缺少几何特征; 不能自动套用修复
disposition: 与DFR反面证据共同使用; 拒绝单一starvation确诊

title: On Lazy Training in Differentiable Programming
authors: Lenaic Chizat; Edouard Oyallon; Francis Bach
direct_support: 缩放可使非线性训练轨迹接近初始化线性化; 给出路径和附条件收敛分析
report_inference: 读出优先或低TRAIN拟合不能直接叫NTK-lazy
assumptions_and_limits: 特定尺度和光滑性及强凸性或秩等条件; 当前没有线性化轨迹证据
disposition: 用于概念界定; 不推荐仅靠增宽或增LR摆脱lazy

title: Last Layer Re-Training is Sufficient for Robustness to Spurious Correlations
authors: Polina Kirichenko; Pavel Izmailov; Andrew Gordon Wilson
direct_support: 若干spurious-correlation基准中ERM隐藏表示已有核心特征; 平衡数据重训读出可利用
report_inference: 最终漏选不能证明特征未形成; 截距校准失败不能否定任意隐藏表示读出
assumptions_and_limits: 需要合适的平衡组与重加权数据; 不等同方法winner平衡; 不可用VAL标签训练当前模型
nearest_history: R67 staged representation/readout; R78 fixed readout; R101
disposition: 保留读出不足这一竞争解释; 不提出违规平衡留出训练

title: Overcoming Simplicity Bias in Deep Networks using a Feature Sieve
direct_support: 通过辅助读出与周期遗忘处理早期简单特征; 也讨论简单特征可有效
report_inference: 若规模和容量本就是合法优势机制则不宜盲目抹除
assumptions_and_limits: 论文的shortcut设置未在当前数据被证明; 均匀遗忘可能损伤正确判别
disposition: 不将Feature Sieve换名作为立即推荐方向

title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
authors: Tianhe Yu; Saurabh Kumar; Abhishek Gupta; Sergey Levine; Karol Hausman; Chelsea Finn
direct_support: 负梯度冲突与幅度和曲率共同构成有害条件; 两任务单步改善有附加假设
report_inference: 负余弦比例不足以认定共享干扰是主瓶颈
assumptions_and_limits: 局部两任务理论不覆盖18任务AdamW所有路径; R64已直接尝试
nearest_history: R64 PCGrad; R69 task-private; R109; R111
disposition: 已有阴性或小收益须降低同类假说优先级

title: On the training dynamics of deep networks with L2 regularization
sections_read: Section 2 empirical time scale; Section 3 schedule limits; Section 4 Theorem 1
direct_support: L2正则与LR和训练步数耦合; 无限宽齐次网络下可分析函数与核动力学
report_inference: 要区分直接收缩和路径效应; 当前WD收缩0.0576%上界为本报告独立协议推导
assumptions_and_limits: 定理依赖齐次性无限宽及相关函数猜想; SGD L2不能直接替代AdamW解耦WD
disposition: 不把所有低拟合归咎强WD; 不推荐未经证据的减WD续训

title: Deep Double Descent: Where Bigger Models and More Data Hurt
authors: Preetum Nakkiran; Gal Kaplun; Yamini Bansal; Tristan Yang; Boaz Barak; Ilya Sutskever
sections_read: Section 6 epoch-wise double descent; Section 7 sample-wise nonmonotonicity
direct_support: 训练时间和样本规模对泛化可以非单调
report_inference: 独立样本数和重复曝光不能用同一个epoch口径替代
assumptions_and_limits: 插值附近特定设置不证明当前71%平台最终会grok或二次下降
disposition: 学习时钟需拆分; 不作无限长训理由

title: Just Train Twice: Improving Group Robustness without Training Group Information
authors: Evan Zheran Liu; Behzad Haghgoo; Annie S. Chen; Aditi Raghunathan; Pang Wei Koh; Shiori Sagawa; Percy Liang; Chelsea Finn
direct_support: 固定第一轮错例后再加权训练以改善worst-group robustness
report_inference: 难例重加权改变目标; 与R95逆概率保持经验风险不同
assumptions_and_limits: worst-group不等于自然microaccuracy; 验证调参信息假设不能改写当前数据规则
nearest_history: R95 importance sampling; R84 focal; R85 EQL
disposition: 不把R95阴性泛化为所有hard mining失败; 也不因此推荐JTT续训

title: Understanding deep learning requires rethinking generalization
authors: Chiyuan Zhang; Samy Bengio; Moritz Hardt; Benjamin Recht; Oriol Vinyals
sections_read: Section 2.1 random-label and random-pixel fitting; Section 3 regularization experiments
direct_support: 有限数据可被过参数化网络记忆且常见正则不完全阻止
report_inference: R49小子集memorization不是当前大样本可迁移判别证据
assumptions_and_limits: 不意味着当前标签随机; 不给出当前模型全81k可拟合保证
disposition: 严格区分记忆能力与自然任务恢复

title: Smart "Predict, then Optimize"
sections_read: Section 3.2 Definition 3.5 and Proposition 3.6; Section 4 Theorem 4.2
direct_support: SPO+优化真实成本诱导的决策surrogate; Fisher consistency有分布与可行域条件
report_inference: 有限候选简单形代入化为cost-augmented分类; 不是新成本信息; 本文给出代入公式
assumptions_and_limits: 条件成本中心对称和连续性等未经证明; 简单形缺环境空间内部; 一致性不针对winnerTop1
nearest_history: R71 joint cost; R78 cost head; R82 CMR; R85 cost profile
disposition: 不把SPO+命名作为第三条新主方向
